intro: This Privacy Policy explains what data broto collects, how we use that information, and what your rights are. By creating an account and using the app, you agree to the practices described here.
section1Body:
• Sign-up details: name, username, email and password — or your Google account details, if you sign in with Google.
• A profile photo, if you choose to add one.
• Photos you submit of plants, used for identification, diagnosis, growth tracking, trade/giveaway listings and community posts.
• Your approximate location, used only when you open the map or check the distance to a listing or event — broto does not track your location in the background.
• Messages exchanged with other users in chat, and messages you send to broto's AI assistant.
• Your device's push notification identifier, used to send reminders and alerts.
• Information about your subscription and credits (plan, status, dates) — broto never has access to your card number; payments are handled entirely by Apple, Google Play and RevenueCat.
section2Body:
• Create and maintain your account.
• Identify plants and diagnose health issues using artificial intelligence.
• Show you plants, listings and events from other users near you.
• Power the community: posts, likes, comments and badges.
• Send notifications about care reminders, messages and community activity.
• Manage your subscription and credit balance.
section3Title: Who we share your data with
section3Body:
broto never sells your data. We only share information with service providers needed to run the app:

• OpenAI — processes the photos and text you submit for plant identification, diagnosis, growth tracking and conversations with the AI assistant.
• Supabase — hosts our database, login, photo storage and server functions.
• RevenueCat — manages subscriptions and in-app purchases.
• Google — used for Google sign-in and to display the map (Google Maps).
• Expo — relays push notifications to your device.

broto currently doesn't use any analytics or behavior-tracking tool inside the app.
section4Body: Your data travels encrypted (HTTPS) and is stored on Supabase's servers, protected by access rules that ensure each user can only see their own private data, such as diagnoses and messages.
section5Title: How long we keep your data
section5Body: When you delete a plant, post, event or listing, it stops appearing to you and other users immediately. The record may be kept for a period for security and history purposes before being permanently removed from our servers.
section7Body: Account deletion is currently handled by request via email. Contact us at the address below and we'll remove your personal data within 30 days.
section8Body: broto is not directed at anyone under 18. If you're responsible for a minor who used the app without your authorization, contact us so we can remove their data.
section9Body: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes to the app or to applicable law. Significant changes will be announced inside the app.
